blocks.h2: Leak Repair Questions From Mokena Homeowners

items.q: How do you find a hidden leak?
items.preview: Listening tools, moisture meters and pressure tests.
items.answer: We use listening equipment, moisture meters and pressure tests to narrow it down before we open anything.

items.q: Will you have to cut into my wall?
items.answer: Usually only a small opening at the leak. We locate it first so we cut as little as possible.

items.q: How can I check for a leak myself?
items.preview: Watch your water meter with everything off.
items.answer: Turn off every fixture and watch the water meter. If it moves, you have a leak somewhere.

items.preview: Sudden damage often, slow leaks often not.
items.answer: Policies vary. Sudden damage is often covered, but slow leaks often aren't. Check with your agent.

items.q: Can you find a leak in the slab or under a finished basement floor?
items.preview: Usually, with pressure tests and listening tools.
items.answer: Usually. We isolate sections of the system with pressure tests and use listening equipment to narrow down the spot before we open the floor.

items.q: How much does leak repair cost in Mokena?
items.preview: It depends on the leak. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the leak is and how we reach it. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
